blind.description: A stylized fantasy or medieval distillation apparatus mounted on a circular wooden plate. A spherical olive-green glass retort rests upon a dark iron tripod stand above a small brass burner. A copper conical cap with a curving swan-neck condenser pipe extends from the top of the flask into a secondary copper receiver flask beside it. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized.
blind.from_above: A circular brown disc topped with a large olive-green sphere that has a copper peak at its center, connected via a curved copper tube to a smaller copper spherical vessel.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (roughly 1.5 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet wide across the base.

notes: footprint proportion 1.49x off the catalog (1.8 x 1.8 ft)
